description: Get live CEX spot-transfer arbitrage routes (buy on one exchange, withdraw, deposit and sell on another) after exact network matching (ambiguous network names refused), token-contract matching, withdrawal/deposit status and minimums, withdrawal fees, per-venue taker fees (buyTakerFee, sellTakerFee), depth and slippage. netReturn is the net per trip as a fraction of the notional (0.001 is 0.1%), like every spread, fee and slippage figure; minNet filters it as a fraction. Routes netting above zero come first (executionStatus executable); up to 50 near-miss routes follow as indicative with indicativeReason below_fees (or stale_quote / stale_network). Books are judged on 60 s, networks on 10 minutes. transferConfirmations is the sell venue's deposit confirmation count (transferEta is its deprecated label); meta.transferScan counts coins scanned, venues answering, routes evaluated and profitable, and the best net (bestNetReturn).

coin.description: Optional base coin ticker, for example BTC, ETH, or SOL.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page.

exchanges.description: Comma-separated exchange filter, for example Binance,Bybit,OKX.

minDepthUsd.description: Minimum executable depth in USD when available.

minNet.description: Minimum of the board's net figure, as a fraction (0.05 is 5%): `netApr` on the dated basis board, `netRollApy` on the calendar board, `netCarryApr` (the fee-adjusted annualized net carry, not the edge to expiry) on the perp-dated carry board, `netReturn` (per trip, not annualized) on the CEX transfer board.

notional.description: Position notional in USD. On the dated-futures basis, calendar-spread and perp-dated carry scanners a row is executable only when its book depth (level 1 on the stored snapshot; on a live read a top-20 walk where level 1 is thin, the side then priced at that walk's VWAP), any reported open interest and its 24h volume are at least this notional (and its quotes are at most 10 minutes old). The CEX spot transfer scanner sizes its order-book fills with it.

name: get_arbitrage_cex_spot_transfer

buyTakerFee.description: Spot taker fee charged on the buy fill, a fraction (0.001 is 0.1%): the venue catalog's own when it reports one, else the shared venue fee table.

executionStatus.description: Executable: fresh books and networks, both books fill the notional, net profit above zero.

isStale.description: An order book older than the 60 s quote SLA, or a transfer-network read older than 10 minutes.

netReturn.description: [VWAP_sell(q - withdrawFee) x (1 - sellTakerFee) - N x (1 + buyTakerFee)] / N, a fraction of the notional N per trip, not annualized (0.001 is 0.1%). At or below zero on near-miss rows (`indicativeReason: below_fees`).

networkUpdatedAt.description: The older of the two venues' transfer-network reads.

spreadLifetimeSeconds.description: How long this server instance has seen the route continuously; resets on a cold start or another instance.

transferConfirmations.description: Deposit confirmations the sell venue waits for on the route's network; null when it does not report them.

transferEta.description: Deprecated: `transferConfirmations` as a label ("15 confs"), not a time.

updatedAt.description: The older of the two order books (quote time).

bestNetReturn.description: Best `netReturn` over evaluated routes, a fraction of the notional per trip (0.001 is 0.1%); null when none was evaluated.

routesEvaluated.description: Directed (coin, buy venue, sell venue) routes with a computed net: both books fill the notional on one common open network.

routesProfitable.description: Evaluated routes netting above zero after fees.

status.description: not_live: the venue's public spot ticker shows no live book (left out of coverage); failed/no_books/no_networks make the answer degraded.

venuesAnswering.description: Selected venues that returned at least one order book and one transfer network.

freshnessSlaSeconds.description: Seconds a row's snapshot stays fresh: 7,200 on the dated basis, calendar and carry boards (the term-structure SLA; the envelope's `freshness_sla_seconds` is 7,200 when the hourly term structure answered and 600 when the 5-minute dated-quotes snapshot did, its `dataset_id` says which), 60 on the CEX transfer board (its order books, the envelope's `freshness_sla_seconds`; transfer networks are judged on 10 minutes per row).

source.description: Where the board's rows came from: the stored hourly term-structure snapshot, a stored snapshot past its SLA, the venues read live (on request, or by the 5-minute dated-quotes snapshot the arbitrage-boards cron writes: then the envelope's `dataset_id` is `arbitrage_dated_quotes` and `served_from` is `snapshot`; always `live` on the CEX transfer board), or nothing. The upstream source ids are in the X-Data-Source header.

stale.description: True when `updatedAt` is older than `freshnessSlaSeconds`. Each row carries its own `isStale` by the same threshold.

supportedCoins.description: The coins the board covers: the supported basis coins on the dated boards; the coins the scan fetched on the CEX transfer board.

meta.description: Which route answered, what the API said about the data's freshness, and whether the client cut the answer to fit the agent's context window.

route.description: Always `v1`: every call reads the keyed /v1 route.

truncated.description: True when the answer is cut short: by the API's row budget, or by the client (`truncated_fields`).

truncated_fields.description: The arrays and strings the client cut, by JSON path in `data`: `total` items received, `showing` kept, `kept: latest` when an oldest-first series kept its newest items.

warnings.description: What the API or the client could not do, in words. State them with the answer.

pagination.description: Present when the answer is one page: pass `cursor` back to read the next one.

title: CEX spot-transfer arbitrage scanner
